landing_background_settings_selection_ch.name: landing_background_settings_selection_check
landing_background_settings_selection_ch.value:
("landing_background_settings"."mode" = 'preset'
      AND "landing_background_settings"."preset_id" IN ('neon-orbit','crystal-ledger','quantum-grid','liquid-token','aurora-chain','prism-vault','network-bloom','electric-canyon','cosmic-exchange','blueprint-future')
      AND "landing_background_settings"."custom_object_path" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("landing_background_settings"."mode" = 'custom'
      AND "landing_background_settings"."preset_id" IS NULL
      AND "landing_background_settings"."custom_object_path" ~ '^/objects/landing-backgrounds/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')

social_trust.name: social_trust
social_trust.default: '{"socialTitle":"Stay connected with us","trustTitle":"Share your feedback with us","appearance":{"iconSize":16,"logoSize":72,"circleSize":36,"borderThickness":1,"radiusMode":"circle","backgroundColor":"#111827","borderColor":"#374151","glowColor":"#6366f1","glowIntensity":0,"iconOpacity":100},"items":[]}'::jsonb

website_branding_paths_check.name: website_branding_paths_check
website_branding_paths_check.value:
("website_branding_settings"."light_logo_path" IS NULL OR "website_branding_settings"."light_logo_path" ~ '^/objects/website-branding/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
    AND ("website_branding_settings"."dark_logo_path" IS NULL OR "website_branding_settings"."dark_logo_path" ~ '^/objects/website-branding/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
    AND ("website_branding_settings"."mobile_logo_path" IS NULL OR "website_branding_settings"."mobile_logo_path" ~ '^/objects/website-branding/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
    AND ("website_branding_settings"."favicon_path" IS NULL OR "website_branding_settings"."favicon_path" ~ '^/objects/website-branding/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')

blog_articles_schedule_check.name: blog_articles_schedule_check
blog_articles_schedule_check.value:
("blog_articles"."status" <> 'scheduled' OR "blog_articles"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("blog_articles"."status" <> 'published' OR "blog_articles"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
